title: Celery delivery preserves portable command lifecycle
description:
As a platform operator, I want Celery-delivered commands to use the portable lifecycle contract, so that command ownership, progress, cancellation, and terminal settlement remain consistent across deployment targets.

Feature: Celery command delivery uses the portable lifecycle

Scenario: A Celery delivery owns and completes a command
Given an announced command envelope and an available lifecycle lease
When the Celery adapter receives the delivery
Then it claims the command through the portable lifecycle
And it executes through the portable executor context
And it acknowledges only after durable terminal settlement

Scenario: A duplicate delivery does not execute concurrently
Given a command with an active portable lifecycle lease
When another Celery delivery receives the same envelope
Then it does not execute the command
And it uses the configured transport behavior without changing dashboard lifecycle semantics

Scenario: Cancellation is observed through the portable context
Given a running Celery-delivered command whose lifecycle is cancellation-requested
When the executor checks its context
Then it terminates as cancelled
And no successful terminal result is written.
